t: You are near the site of Horsemonger Lane Gaol, a south London prison close to present-day Newington Causeway in Southwark. It was built at the end of the 18th century and used until 1878. It is best remembered for executions. In 1849 Frederick and Marie Manning were hanged on its roof for the murder of her lover, Patrick O'Connor, in the case known as the Bermondsey Horror. It was the first time a husband and wife had been executed together in England since 1700. In 1870 Margaret Waters was hanged here too.
